001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.ReloadResult;
005import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.ReloadStatus;
006import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.Reloadable;
007import org.bukkit.World;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
010
011/**
012 * Abstract Economy Core
013 */
014public abstract class AbstractEconomy implements EconomyCore, Reloadable {
015
016  protected AbstractEconomy() {
017
018  }
019
020  @Override
021  public @NotNull String getName() {
022
023    return "BuiltIn-Economy Processor";
024  }
025
026  @Override
027  public abstract boolean withdraw(@NotNull QUser obj, double amount, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
028
029  @Override
030  public abstract boolean deposit(@NotNull QUser obj, double amount, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
031
032  @Override
033  public abstract double getBalance(@NotNull QUser obj, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
034
035  @Override
036  public boolean transfer(@NotNull final QUser from, @NotNull final QUser to, final double amount, @NotNull final World world, @Nullable final String currency) {
037
038    if(!isValid()) {
039      return false;
040    }
041    if(this.getBalance(from, world, currency) >= amount) {
042      if(this.withdraw(from, amount, world, currency)) {
043        if(this.deposit(to, amount, world, currency)) {
044          this.deposit(from, amount, world, currency);
045          return false;
046        }
047        return true;
048      }
049      return false;
050    }
051    return false;
052  }
053
054  public abstract String getProviderName();
055
056  /**
057   * Callback for reloading
058   *
059   * @return Reloading success
060   */
061  @Override
062  public ReloadResult reloadModule() {
063
064    return ReloadResult.builder().status(ReloadStatus.SUCCESS).build();
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public abstract String toString();
069}
